name: System Monitoring
description: System Monitoring dashboards helps you to monitor changes related to Jenkins Configuration, Job Configuration, health of the Jenkins Master, performance of Job Queue, performance of Job Run Duration, health of all the slaves available within the Jenkins Master.

children.name: Jenkins - Audit
children.description: The Jenkins - Audit dashboard provides insights into all authentication activities. Panels display information on Jenkins system and job configuration changes, as well as job run activities.
children.title: Jenkins - Audit

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Job_Started", "Job_Aborted", "Job_Finished") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| timeslice 10m
| count as Count by _timeslice, Event
| transpose row _timeslice column Event
| fillmissing timeslice(10m)

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Config_Change") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| parse regex "file (?<Item_Name>.*?).xml"
| concat(Item_Name, ".xml") as ItemName
| where !(ItemName matches "jobs/*")
| count as Count by ItemName
| sort by Count
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Config_Change") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| parse regex "file (?<ItemName>.*?).xml"
| concat(ItemName, ".xml") as ItemName
| where ItemName matches "jobs/*"
| parse field=ItemName "jobs/*/config.xml" as JobName
| count as Count by JobName
| sort by Count
| limit 5

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Config_Change") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| json "fileDetails.Current_File_Data", "fileDetails.Old_File_Data" as Current_File_Data, Old_File_Data nodrop
| base64Decode(Current_File_Data) as Current_File_Data
| base64Decode(Old_File_Data) as Old_File_Data
| count as Count by Time, Master, Event, UserName, UserId, Message
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("User_Login", "User_Logout", "User_Login_Failure") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as Count by Time, Master, Event, UserName, UserId, Message
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Created", "Deleted", "Updated", "Copied", "Location_Changed") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as Count by Time, Master, Event, UserName, UserId, Message
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where Event in ("Job_Started", "Job_Aborted", "Job_Finished") and userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as Count by Time, Master, Event, UserName, UserId, Message
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Audit_Event
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "userName", "auditEventType", "userId", "message", "eventTime" as UserName, Event, UserId, Message, Time nodrop
| where userName matches "{{UserName}}" and userId matches "{{UserId}}" and Event matches "{{Event}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"

children.name: Jenkins - Job Health
children.description: The Jenkins - Job Health dashboard provides insight into the health of the Jenkins Jobs. Panels display information on Jenkins Job Count, Jenkins Job Run Duration, Jenkins Queue Information and Garbage Collections.
children.title: Jenkins - Job Health

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.job.total.duration.mean | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.job.total.duration.mean" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1000
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.job.waiting.duration.mean | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.job.waiting.duration.mean" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1000
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.job.queuing.duration.mean | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.job.queuing.duration.mean" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1000
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.job.blocked.duration.mean | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.job.blocked.duration.mean" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1000
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.queue.size.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.queue.size.value" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.queue.pending.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.queue.pending.value" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.queue.buildable.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.queue.buildable.value" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.queue.blocked.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.queue.blocked.value" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.vm.gc.*.count | parse field=_rawName "*.vm.gc.*.count" as prefix, name
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.vm.gc.*.time | parse field=_rawName "*.vm.gc.*.time" as prefix, name | eval _value/60

children.name: Jenkins - Master Health
children.description: The Jenkins - Master Health dashboard provides insight into the health of the Jenkins master. Panels display information on shutdown events, Jenkins system logs, and metrics events such as CPU, memory,  jenkins threads, jenkins executors.
children.title: Jenkins - Master Health

queries.queryString: _sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.*.cpu.load | parse field=_rawName "*.vm.cpu.load" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.vm.memory.total.used | parse field=_rawName "*.vm.memory.total.used" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1024/1024

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Jenkins_Log
| json "threadId", "logType", "logLevel", "logMessage", "logSource", "eventTime", "logStackTrace" as %"Thread ID", %"Log Type", %"Log Level", %"Log Message", %"Log Source", %"Event Time", %"Log Stack Trace" nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
//| where Master matches {{Master}} AND %"Log Level" matches {{LogLevel}} AND %"Log Message" matches {{LogMessage}}
| count by Master, %"Event Time", %"Thread ID", %"Log Type", %"Log Level", %"Log Source", %"Log Message", %"Log Stack Trace"
| sort by %"Event Time"
| fields - _count
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.*.cpu.load | parse field=_rawName "*.system.cpu.load" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.vm.memory.heap.used | parse field=_rawName "*.vm.memory.heap.used" as MetricPrefix | eval _value/1024/1024

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* "\"eventSource\":\"Shutdown\"" 
| _sourceHost as Master
| timeslice 10m
|where Master matches "*"
|count as Count by _timeslice, Master
| transpose row _timeslice column Master
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.executor.count.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.executor.count.value" as MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.jenkins.executor.in-use.value | parse field=_rawName "*.jenkins.executor.in-use.value" as MetricPrefix
#B/#A * 100 along MetricPrefix
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* *.vm.runnable.count | parse field=_rawName "*.*" as MetricPrefix, unused

children.name: Jenkins - Node Health
children.description: The Jenkins - Node Health dashboard provides insights into the health of all the nodes present on the Jenkins master. Panels display information on disk usage, physical Memory usage, as well as free and busy executors.
children.title: Jenkins - Node Health

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| json field=Message "nodeName", "monitorData.ArchitectureMonitor", "monitorData.ClockMonitor" ,"monitorData.ResponseTimeMonitor", "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor", "monitorData.TemporarySpaceMonitor", "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "isIdle", "isOnline", "nodeURL", "nodeLabel"  as %"Node Name", Architecture, Clock, %"Reponse Time", %"Free Disk Space", Temporary_Space, SwapMemory, Idle, Online, URL, %"Node Label" nodrop
| if(Idle matches "true", "false", "true") as Busy
| parse field=SwapMemory "Memory:*  Swap:*" as Physical_Memory, Swap_Memory
| parse regex field=Physical_Memory "(?<Free_Physical_Memory>.*?)/(?<Total_Physical_Memory>.*?)(?<Unit_Phy>[A-Z]+)"
| num(Free_Physical_Memory) | num(Total_Physical_Memory)
| (Free_Physical_Memory/Total_Physical_Memory)*100 as Free_Physical_Memory
| parse regex field=Swap_Memory "(?<Free_Swap_Memory>.*?)/(?<Total_Swap_Memory>.*?)(?<Unit_Swap>[A-Z]+)"
| num(Free_Swap_Memory) | num(Total_Swap_Memory)
| (Free_Swap_Memory/Total_Swap_Memory)*100 as Free_Swap_Memory
| if(Total_Physical_Memory=0, "0 %", format("%.2f %s",Free_Physical_Memory, "%")) as %"Free Physical Memory"
| if(Total_Swap_Memory=0, "0 %", format("%.2f %s",Free_Swap_Memory, "%")) as %"Free Swap Memory" 
| replace(URL, "(", "%28") as URL
| replace(URL, ")", "%29") as URL
| tourl(URL, %"Node Name") as URL
| count by Master, %"Node Name", %"Node Label", Busy, Online, Architecture, Clock, %"Reponse Time", %"Free Physical Memory", %"Free Swap Memory", %"Free Disk Space", URL
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| json field=Message "nodeName", "monitorData.ArchitectureMonitor", "monitorData.ClockMonitor" ,"monitorData.ResponseTimeMonitor", "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor", "monitorData.TemporarySpaceMonitor", "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "isIdle", "isOnline", "nodeURL", "nodeLabel"  as %"Node Name", Architecture, Clock, Reponse_Time, Disk_Space, Temporary_Space, SwapMemory, Idle, Online, URL, %"Node Label" nodrop
| if(Idle matches "true", "false", "true") as Busy
| where busy = "true"
| count as Count by Busy

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| json field=Message "nodeName", "monitorData.ArchitectureMonitor", "monitorData.ClockMonitor" ,"monitorData.ResponseTimeMonitor", "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor", "monitorData.TemporarySpaceMonitor", "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "isIdle", "isOnline", "nodeURL", "nodeLabel"  as %"Node Name", Architecture, Clock, Reponse_Time, Disk_Space, Temporary_Space, SwapMemory, Idle, Online, URL, %"Node Label" nodrop
| if(Idle matches "true", "false", "true") as Busy
| where busy = "false"
| count as Count by Busy

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| json field=Message "nodeName", "monitorData.ArchitectureMonitor", "monitorData.ClockMonitor" ,"monitorData.ResponseTimeMonitor", "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor", "monitorData.TemporarySpaceMonitor", "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "isIdle", "isOnline", "nodeURL", "nodeLabel"  as Node_Name, Architecture, Clock, Reponse_Time, Disk_Space, Temporary_Space, SwapMemory, Idle, Online, URL, Label nodrop
| where Online = "true"
| count as Count by Online

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| json field=Message "nodeName", "monitorData.ArchitectureMonitor", "monitorData.ClockMonitor" ,"monitorData.ResponseTimeMonitor", "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor", "monitorData.TemporarySpaceMonitor", "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "isIdle", "isOnline", "nodeURL", "nodeLabel"  as Node_Name, Architecture, Clock, Reponse_Time, Disk_Space, Temporary_Space, SwapMemory, Idle, Online, URL, Label nodrop
| where Online = "false"
| count as Count by Online

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Job_Status
| json "nodeName", "name", "result", "jobBuildURL", "number" as NodeName, JobName, Result, jobBuildURL, Number nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| tourl(jobBuildURL, JobName) as JobName
| JobName as %"Job Name"
| NodeName as %"Node Name"
| count by Master, %"Node Name", %"Job Name", Number, Result
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "isOnline", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount, Onilne, NodeLabel nodrop
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| where ExecutorsCount > 0 AND Onilne matches "true"
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| concat(Master, "-", NodeName) as %"Node Name"
| json field=_raw "monitorData.DiskSpaceMonitor" as Disk_Space
| parse regex field=Disk_Space "(?<Disk_Space>.*?) (?<Unit>.*[A-Z]+)" nodrop
| num(Disk_Space)
| if(Unit in ("MB", "Mb", "mb"), Disk_Space/1024, if(Unit in ("KB", "Kb", "kb"), Disk_Space/1024/1024, if(Unit in ("TB", "Tb", "tb"), Disk_Space*1024, Disk_Space))) as Disk_Space
| timeslice 10m
| avg(Disk_Space) as Disk_Space by _timeslice, %"Node Name"
| transpose row _timeslice column %"Node Name"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "isOnline", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount, Onilne, NodeLabel nodrop
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| where ExecutorsCount > 0 AND Onilne matches "true"
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master 
| compose NodeName, Master]
| concat(Master, "-", NodeName) as NodeName
| json field=Message "monitorData.SwapSpaceMonitor", "nodeLabel"  as SwapMemory, Node_Label nodrop
| parse field=SwapMemory "Memory:*  Swap:*" as Physical_Memory, Swap_Memory
| parse regex field=Physical_Memory "(?<Free_Memory>.*?)/(?<Total_Memory>.*?)[A-Z]"
| Free_Memory/Total_Memory as Free_Memory
| 1 - Free_Memory as Used_Memory
| avg(Used_Memory) as %"Used Memory", avg(Free_Memory) as %"Free Memory" by NodeName

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* ("Computer_Offline")
| _sourceHost as Master
| json "nodeName", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, NodeLabel nodrop
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| _sourceHost as Jenkins_Master
| concat ("Master=",Master," Node=", NodeName) as %"Master Node Name" 
| timeslice 10m
| count as Count by _timeslice, %"Master Node Name"
| transpose row _timeslice column %"Master Node Name"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* ("Launch_Failure")
| json "nodeName", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, NodeLabel nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| concat ("Master=",Master," Node=", NodeName) as %"Master Node Name" 
| timeslice 10m
| count as Count by _timeslice, %"Master Node Name"
| transpose row _timeslice column %"Master Node Name"

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| count as Count by Time, NodeName, Master 
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* ("Computer_Online" OR "Computer_Offline" OR "Computer_Temp_Online" OR "Computer_Temp_Offline" OR "Launch_Failure")
| json "nodeName", "eventSource", "eventTime", "nodeLabel", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeURL" as NodeName, Event, Time, NodeLabel, Executors, Node_URL nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| NodeName as %"Node Name"
| NodeLabel as %"Node Label"
| replace(Node_URL, "(", "%28") as Node_URL
| replace(Node_URL, ")", "%29") as Node_URL
| tourl(Node_URL, %"Node Name") as %"Node URL"
| count as Count by Time, Master, Event, %"Node Name", %"Node Label", Executors, %"Node URL"
| sort by Time
| fields - Count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors", "nodeLabel" as NodeName, ExecutorsCount,NodeLabel
| _sourceHost as Master
| first(_raw) as Message by NodeName, Master
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master  
| compose NodeName, Master] 
| json field=Message "nodeName","isOnline" as %"Node Name",Online
| where (Online = "true" or Online = "false")
| count(%"Node Name") by %"Node Name", Online
| fields - _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"updated"
| json "numberOfExecutors", "nodeName", "nodeLabel", "numberOfFreeExecutors", "eventTime" as Total_Executors, NodeName, NodeLabel, Free_Executors, Event_Time nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| where NodeName matches "{{NodeName}}" and NodeLabel matches "{{NodeLabel}}" and Master matches "{{Master}}"
| concat(Master, "-",NodeName) as NodeName
| Total_Executors - Free_Executors as Busy_Executors
| first(Total_Executors) as Total_Executors, first(Free_Executors) as Free_Executors, first(Busy_Executors) as Busy_Executors by NodeName
| where Busy_Executors >= 0
| where ![subquery:_sourceCategory = Labs/Jenkins* Periodic_Update "nodeStatus":"removed"
| json "eventTime", "nodeName", "numberOfExecutors" as Time, NodeName, ExecutorsCount nodrop
| _sourceHost as Master
| count as Count by NodeName, Master
| concat(Master, "-",NodeName) as NodeName
| compose NodeName]
| NodeName as %"Node Name"
| avg(Free_Executors) as %"Free Executors", avg(Busy_Executors) as %"Busy Executors" by %"Node Name"
| fields %"Node Name", %"Free Executors", %"Busy Executors"
